column1: # The geometry fixtures the service queries, one row per profile. A request
# names a profile_id and a ray count and nothing else the query reads: the
# scene, the query set, and the device belong to the row, so a caller chooses
# among fixtures and supplies no geometry, native code, path, or OptiX or CUDA
# flag. The service validates the ledger whole before it answers a request,
# profile_id       the name a request carries
# scene            the fixture the runtime builds; the runtime refuses a name it
# query_set        the ray set the runtime generates from the count
# max_rays         the ceiling a request's rays is bounded by
# timeout_s        the service's deadline for one job
# execution_policy refused or validator-gated, the same reading the web,
#                  image, and physics ledgers give the field: refused emits
# device_index     the CUDA device the runtime binds
